Description
The 10 x 1/10 oz Valcambi Gold CombiBar is an innovative and unique investment product that provides investors flexibility and convenience. 10 x 1/10 oz Valcambi Gold CombiBar (In Assay)allows customers to purchase one troy ounce of gold that can be separated into smaller pieces, commonly called CombiBar. Valcambi Suisse is one of Europe’s top gold bullion companies in the worldwide precious metals industry. Do not miss the chance to buy 1/10 oz Valcambi Gold CombiBar at the lowest price in Bullon Trading LLC!
In Assay consists of ten individual 1/10 oz gold bars, which are held together by a secure and convenient connection system. Each of the 10x 1/10 oz gold bars contains high-quality
.9999 pure gold
produced by Valcambi. Valcambi is one of the world’s most respected and trusted refiners of the precious metal industry. Each CombiBar is individually sealed with an assay card that guarantees its authenticity and purity.
Design of the 10 x 1/10 oz Valcambi Gold CombiBar
The 10x 1/10 oz Valcambi Gold CombiBar features the Valcambi logo as well as weight and purity. They combine to create a larger 1-ounce Valcambi bar. This information is shown in reverse. The mint, “1 oz” weight, and purity are all listed. The compact size of each bar can also make it easy to store and transport. In addition to this, the bar also has a unique serial number. Finally, the assay card lists this bar’s weight and authentication details, assuring the buyer of its authenticity.

Each CombiBar is individually sealed with an assay card.
Obverse: Features a single stamped Valcambi logo with weight and purity.

Utilizes Valcambi’s patented CombiBar technology.
